title: EngineModels
description: `GET /engines/:engine/models`: the models of an engine's installation, and the modes it runs in (plan 13, B-13; plan 28, B-36) — from the engine's installation, never a list in the code.

version.description: The version of the engine that answered, or `null` when it could not tell.

permissionModes.description: The modes the engine runs in, every one of them — the screen says which can be a default.
